scope_reviewed: three learning packs, worked examples, and residue files
findings: Cases 6 and 7 have no proposition-level facts, rules, or solutions in reviewed tower artifacts; substantive answer keys are blocked.
Node browsing does not prove that a learner can formulate the next right question; the contract needs a deterministic missing-dimension-to-interrogative mapping.
Source disagreement and OCR uncertainty must remain learner-visible answer conditions.
The safe pilot is deterministic element selection, provenance inspection, and abstention—not model-generated doctrinal completion.

supported_questions: actor status, object, and acquisition form
Case 6/7 operator slots without supplying facts
toy_game.unsupported_control: Request one definitive period-independent rule for every possession dispute; expected result is abstention plus a bounded research question.
toy_game.answer_boundary: Compare tower-derived element IDs and evidence-status fields only; normalize case and whitespace, never semantic similarity.
toy_game.wrong_answer_rule: Return the first missing element in a declared order, one exact evidence target, and exactly one interrogative next question.

validation: identical or permuted inputs produce identical IDs and results
every supported element resolves to an existing tower selector and page when present
keyboard-only flow, focus/status announcement, non-color evidence states, reduced motion, and no hidden-node focus traps

blockers: Populated doctrinal answers for Cases 6 and 7 require page-image-verified proposition ledgers.
reroute: Page-specific tower extension before substantive case-answer gameplay
handoff_note: The decisive witness is deterministic production of the smallest evidence-backed next question from one specific omission.
